name: surfaces-analytics
description: Data and analytics work with Surfaces UI: skills for chart and dashboard standards after Tufte and Few, human-in-the-loop patterns, connecting and onboarding, cleaning, personal data, transformations and responsive, accessible UI, with the Surfaces MCP server that draws live tables, charts and dashboards over your own data.

data_dialect.title: Database type
data_dialect.description: The database your own data is in, when it is reached through that database's MCP server. Leave as sample data to try the plugin with the built-in sample datasets.

data_server.title: The database's MCP server
data_server.description: How that server is started on this computer, for example: uvx teradata-mcp-server. Or its address, starting with https://. Leave empty for sample data.

data_secret.title: Connection string or token
data_secret.description: What the database's MCP server needs to sign in: its connection string for a server started here, or the token for one at an address. Kept in this computer's credential store and handed only to that server.

data_secret_name.title: Name the connection string is passed under
data_secret_name.description: The environment variable the database's MCP server reads its connection string from. DATABASE_URI for the Teradata MCP server; change it only if your server reads another name.
